# Synthetic evaluation key

These invented labels are for evaluating source fidelity. They carry no clinical meaning.

- In lecture.pdf the Mica tray holds amber tiles on page 1. The Lumen tray holds blue tiles on page 2. Page 3 is intentionally blank and should produce zero cards.
- In table.pdf Sample Alder has 12 circles and Sample Birch has 21 circles. Check the row, unit and value together.
- In note.png the labeled diagram gives North cup = green dots and South cup = gold bars. The unlabeled shapes have no stated identity.

Record supported answer, correct citation, and usefulness in quality.csv. Check missed facts against this key. Count unsupported cards and cards attributed to a blank page before comparing costs.
